segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ וְרוֹחֵץ עִמּוֹ בְּאַמְבָּטִי גְּדוֹלָה, אֲבָל לֹא בִּקְטַנָּה. וְיָשֵׁן עִמּוֹ בַּמִּטָּה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «And» with regard to another person who is prohibited from deriving benefit from him, «one may bathe with him in a large bath [ambati],» in which his presence does not affect the other person. «However,» he may «not» bathe with him «in a small» bath, as his presence moderates the temperature of water if it is too hot or too cold, thereby benefiting the other person. «And he may sleep with him in» one «bed.»

segments.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: בִּימוֹת הַחַמָּה, אֲבָל לֹא בִּימוֹת הַגְּשָׁמִים, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא מַהֲנֵהוּ. וּמֵיסֵב עִמּוֹ עַל הַמִּטָּה. וְאוֹכֵל עִמּוֹ עַל הַשּׁוּלְחָן, אֲבָל לֹא מִן הַתַּמְחוּי. אֲבָל אוֹכֵל הוּא עִמּוֹ מִן הַתַּמְחוּי הַחוֹזֵר.
segments.en: «Rabbi Yehuda says:» That is permitted «during the days of summer, but» he may «not» sleep with him in one bed «during the rainy season,» i.e., the winter, «because he benefits him» by warming the bed. «And he may recline with him on a divan» even during the rainy season, as no benefit is involved. «And he may eat with him at» the same «table, but not from» a common «platter» from which several people eat, as if one leaves food on the platter, the other derives benefit from him. «However, he may eat with him from a platter that returns» to the host, as everyone takes a small portion and leaves food on the platter. No benefit is derived. Since there is enough food for everyone, none of the diners receives part of another’s portion.

moves.summary: large bath permitted, small not; may sleep in one bed
only in summer; eating at one table but not from a shared platter
